hypotheses.claim: For cvrp_ruin_recreate at a 500 ms budget on cvrp_dev_hetero_24, a score_ruin_nodes hook of the form score_i = rank_power(|removal_savings_i|/scale, p(iter_frac, stagnation_ratio)) * gate_load * gate_depot * gate_demand * gate_rdist (with p decreasing from ~3 toward ~1 as stagnation_ratio grows) will reduce mean tour length by >=1.0% vs the round-1 incumbent (15.7584), and the gain will concentrate in the tight-capacity / eccentric-depot / n=100 regimes where the round-1 VBS relative gap is worst (-23.4%, -21.2%, -22.2%).

next_search_advice.direction: Evolve the single hook `score_ruin_nodes` into a rank-power multiplicative gating rule that (a) ranks customers by normalized removal savings, (b) multiplies by capacity-tightness and depot-eccentricity gates, and (c) anneals the rank power p with `iter_frac` and `stagnation_ratio` so early iterations remove top-cost nodes and stagnating iterations broaden toward randomized mid-rank removal (diversification). Targets the measured weak regimes of dev_24: capacity_level=tight, depot_style=eccentric, size=100 (uniform demand, clustered spatial).
